color.note: One theme. The app declares color-scheme: light and has no dark mode; every game keeps the light ground and tints it per world.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text and icon strokes. The only text colour on ground, cream, paper, pink-ground, warm-ground and success-ground. Also the logo tile fill.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: level lines, HUD labels, helper text, footer. Reads on ground, cream and paper (6.3:1 on cream).

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind every hub page. Also the hover fill of pace choices.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Panels, dialogs and cards: the warm surface that floats on ground. The logo's wand stroke.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Pure white for number tiles, pills, icon buttons, chips, choice cards and the secondary button. Literal #fff in the source.

tokens.name: paper-veil
tokens.usage: Translucent white behind instruction text and empty slots over a pond or sky gradient.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Brand accent and the primary button fill (white text, 5.6:1). The second word of the wordmark on the home page. Focus accent-color on radios and checkboxes.

tokens.name: pink-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill only.

tokens.name: pink-deep
tokens.usage: Text on pink-ground: active nav link, best score, combo, banners, new-best line, side values (6.4:1).

tokens.name: pink-ground
tokens.usage: Celebration tint: active nav link, hot combo, winning side, selected chip, hat-unlocked badge.

tokens.name: pink-tint
tokens.usage: Text selection background only.

tokens.name: pink-shadow
tokens.usage: The primary button's drop shadow colour; see shadow-primary.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 3px focus-visible outline on every button and link, offset 5px. 7.7:1 on ground and cream.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Correct answer: picked choice border, eaten snack border, empty slot sign. A mark, never body text (3.6:1 on success-tint).

tokens.name: success-strong
tokens.usage: Selected pace choice border and radio accent; the darker green for 18px labels.

tokens.name: success-ground
tokens.usage: Caught-up messages, path markers and the Numbers world's card ground. Starred level cards.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of a picked choice card. Pairs with the success border.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Comparison bar fill and the fourth confetti colour.

tokens.name: leaf-bright
tokens.usage: The 8px ring around each side of the crocodile pond in normal rounds.

tokens.name: warm-ground
tokens.usage: Recommended level card, game cards on the home page, save notes, earned castle stars and the Missing-number world ground.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Operator discs, eaten snacks, the golden pond ring and the left comparison bar. Never text.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Golden snack fill, frenzy ring and frenzy shimmer. Never text.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Golden snack border. 2.9:1 on paper: a mark only, and flagged below 3:1 in the source.

tokens.name: star-ink
tokens.usage: Stroke of an earned star in StarRating. 2.9:1 on cream, in the source as is: the star shape and the label carry the meaning.

tokens.name: star-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of an earned star in StarRating.

tokens.name: star-empty
tokens.usage: Stroke of an unearned star. Outcome stars use #c9c2a8, the same idea.

tokens.name: star-earned-big
tokens.usage: The 48px outcome stars once earned.

tokens.name: amber-ink
tokens.usage: Journey icons for mastered levels and chapters on the home page; golden points float.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Boss snack fill and the third confetti colour.

tokens.name: sky-deep
tokens.usage: Boss round ring, boss banner text and boss snack border.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: The minus operator disc.

tokens.name: lagoon
tokens.usage: Bubble race water, racing bubble border and pace pictograms.

tokens.name: lagoon-ground
tokens.usage: Bubble race panel fill.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: The explored-levels journey icon.

tokens.name: confetti-pink
tokens.usage: The first confetti colour; with sun, sky and leaf.

tokens.name: shake
tokens.usage: Border of a wrong choice while it shakes.

tokens.name: parchment
tokens.usage: The castle game frame and story panels in Defend the Fairy Castle.

tokens.name: parchment-deep
tokens.usage: Spell bar ground and the practice panel in the castle game.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Hint button and ten-frame cells in the castle game.

tokens.name: earth
tokens.usage: Spell quantity dots.

tokens.name: moss-ink
tokens.usage: Rule copy and playtest notes in the castle game (7.3:1 on parchment).

tokens.name: bronze
tokens.usage: The outcome trophy icon in the castle game.

tokens.name: forest-night
tokens.usage: The page behind the castle game frame; the only dark ground in the app.

tokens.name: meadow
tokens.usage: Battle scene ground.

tokens.name: brick-border
tokens.usage: Number wall brick borders.

tokens.name: brick-filled
tokens.usage: Border of a filled number wall brick.

tokens.name: world-numbers
tokens.usage: Emblem colour of the Numbers world; its ground is success-ground.

tokens.name: world-tens
tokens.usage: Emblem colour of the Tens world.

tokens.name: world-tens-ground
tokens.usage: Card ground of the Tens world.

tokens.name: world-missing
tokens.usage: Emblem colour of the Missing-number world; its ground is warm-ground.

tokens.name: croc-pond-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the pond gradient (to pond-mid then pond-deep).

tokens.name: croc-pond-mid
tokens.usage: 70% stop of the pond gradient.

tokens.name: croc-pond-deep
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the pond gradient.

tokens.name: croc-ground
tokens.usage: Page ground behind the crocodile game.

tokens.name: wall-sky
tokens.usage: Top of the number wall page gradient, through ground to wall-grass.

tokens.name: wall-grass
tokens.usage: Bottom of the number wall page gradient.

tokens.name: logo-star
tokens.usage: The star in the logo mark. Logo only.

tokens.name: logo-leaf
tokens.usage: The two leaves in the logo mark. Logo only.

tokens.name: logo-plus
tokens.usage: The small plus in the logo mark. Logo only.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dialog backdrop: ink at 53%.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Home hero only. In code clamp(48px, 5.4vw, 76px); the second word in pink.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles. clamp(30px, 4vw, 48px) in code; regular weight, never semibold.

styles.name: game-title
styles.usage: The h1 inside GameHeader: clamp(22px, 3vw, 30px), 20px under 540px.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section and panel headings. Semibold is what tells an h2 from an h1.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles: chapter stops, level stops, game cards (23px there).

styles.name: world-emblem
styles.usage: The emoji emblem on a world or game card; 110px on the ready card.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Discover the magic of numbers, one little adventure at a time.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a page title, in muted.

styles.name: instruction
styles.sample: Which side does the crocodile eat?
styles.usage: The one line that tells the player what to do, centred over paper-veil.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Work out both sides first. Then feed the crocodile.
styles.usage: Paragraphs. The root size; p gets line-height 1.6.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Nav links, header buttons, chip text, bar numbers.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: HUD labels, status lines, snack counts, world state. Usually muted.

styles.name: footnote
styles.sample: A little curiosity. A world of magic.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Level number above a level card title, uppercase in pink.

styles.name: tile
styles.usage: Numbers on a tile: clamp(30px, 4.1vw, 42px), tabular-nums. 58px on a plain two-number round.

styles.name: operator
styles.usage: The sign inside a 40px operator disc.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: The number in the score pill, tabular-nums; bumps to 135% on change.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Journey counters on the home page, tabular-nums.

styles.name: sign
styles.usage: The comparison sign under a choice crocodile and in the slot.

spacing.note: Four named steps in :root; the rest are the literal gaps the pages repeat.

tokens.name: space-tiny
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked lines in a HUD block; snack gaps are 6px.

tokens.name: space-small
tokens.usage: --space-small: icon-to-label gaps, HUD gaps, star gaps.

tokens.name: space-compact
tokens.usage: Gaps between chips, stars and action buttons; dialog heading margins.

tokens.name: space-medium
tokens.usage: --space-medium: game page gutters, list gaps, card gaps on phones.

tokens.name: space-roomy
tokens.usage: Gap between a card's picture and copy; phone page gutters.

tokens.name: space-large
tokens.usage: --space-large: card padding, grid gaps, section margins.

tokens.name: space-panel
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop (24px on phones).

tokens.name: space-block
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; margin above the journey and games sections.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: --space-section: page padding and the gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-hero
tokens.usage: Column gap in intro grids and bottom page padding.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Language buttons, save notes, bricks, comparison bars.

tokens.name: radius-surface
tokens.usage: --radius-surface: destination cards, chapter stops, level stops, images, pace choices.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Number tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Score pill, combo pill, banners, side values, hat badge.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: --radius-panel: panels, dialogs, nav links, choice cards, game cards, the logo tile.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: --radius-button: every .button, header links and chips. Always a full pill at 56px height.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Icon buttons, operator discs, path markers, play disc, bubbles.

shadow.note: Shadows are ink-blue at very low alpha. Nothing casts a grey shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-rest
tokens.usage: Resting white surfaces: secondary button, icon buttons, chips, score pill, level cards.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Cream panels and the journey card.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Choice cards at rest; 0 9px 20px #214d5a26 on hover.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Banners and the points float that pop over the board.

tokens.name: shadow-primary
tokens.usage: The primary button: a pink shadow under a pink fill.

tokens.name: shadow-tile
tokens.usage: Number tiles: a hard 5px ledge plus a soft drop. Winner tiles swap the ledge to #b9dcc1.

tokens.name: shadow-pond-ring
tokens.usage: Each side of the pond: a thick green ring that turns sun in golden rounds and sky-deep in boss rounds.

tokens.name: shadow-castle
tokens.usage: The castle game frame on forest-night.
